inspection_method: Original RGBA files composited over RGB (128,128,128) and (235,235,235), then personally viewed with tools.view_image; original files preserved.
asset: Bella Sister — cream apron, RE4 original 2005, left

visual_checks.orientation: Head and chainsaw blade face screen left; torso remains largely frontal with a slight leftward turn. This is not a strict lateral combat stance.
visual_checks.costume: Blue-gray buttoned blouse, pale collar, cream full apron over muted purplish/brown long skirt, dark brown shoes and bandaged head match the intended original-game sister. No green-skirt costume substitution.
visual_checks.hands: Two hands are physically attached to handles and neither touches chain teeth. However, tracing each visible arm to its shoulder shows the character’s anatomical RIGHT hand on the forward/top wrap handle and her anatomical LEFT hand on the rear trigger handle. The request specifies LEFT on forward handle and RIGHT on rear handle. This is a grip-laterality mismatch, not an acceptable finalized candidate.
visual_checks.framing: Exactly one full-body woman and one complete chainsaw; bandaged head, both footwear silhouettes, garment hem and blade tip all inside canvas. No base, UI, text, victim or duplicate figure.
blocking_defects: Chainsaw grip reverses requested anatomical hand ownership.
limits: Near-frontal torso does not fully match requested three-quarter side combat stance.
All-side 8 percent margin request is not achieved.
Generated costume texture and exact model geometry are not certified.
Single static pose; no animation, contacts or engine admission.

alpha.halo_finding: Real alpha transparency confirmed. No broad backdrop or substantial halo visible in actual light/gray composites. Low-alpha residual pixels remain; maximum alpha and opaque pixel counts are recorded rather than assumed.

recommended_action: Preserve original PNG as a trial and request a targeted new pose with anatomical left hand on the forward handle and right hand on the rear trigger handle. Keep identity, costume and original-game edition fixed.
